name: todo-extractor
purpose: Extract TODO and FIXME lines from notes.txt, write them with line numbers to todos.md, and output the count of items found.
instructions: Read notes.txt from the workspace. Scan each line for the exact substrings "TODO" or "FIXME" (case-sensitive). Do not perform any network requests, shell commands, or modify files other than notes.txt and todos.md. Never output anything besides the final count.
